title: automate-hsm-kms-and-tls-rotation-for-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Ava Patel
description: Summary: Add automated TLS certificate rotation and KMS/HSM integration for the Private Installer. This PR adds: - Terraform modules and example to provision KMS keys and (optionally) CloudHSM-backed key material for customers using AWS; provider-agnostic hooks for GCP/Azure are included as interfaces. - Helm chart additions for the private-installer to enable hsm.enabled, kms.provider, and vault integration flags; templated RBAC and mutation webhooks to allow rotation controller to push updated TLS secrets without exposing plaintext private keys. - A rotation controller (controller/secrets-rotation) deployed as part of the installer that watches Certificate custom resources and integrates with Vault and PKCS#11-backed HSMs to perform non-exportable key rotations and sign CSR requests. Controller supports two modes: "kms-as-signing" (use KMS Sign APIs) and "hsm-pkcs11" (hsm driver for on-prem HSMs). - Integration with sealed-secrets: added a migration/rehydration path that re-seals updated secrets using the cluster's public sealing key so customers using Bitnami sealed-secrets don't need manual steps during rotation. - Terraform examples for scheduling automatic rotation windows and CloudWatch EventBridge rules for AWS; added a validation step that prevents overlapping rotation windows for clusters in the same VPC. Motivation: Customers running private (VPC/on-prem) deployments have asked for automated key/cert rotation and a path to use HSM/KMS without exporting key material. Manual rotation is error-prone and leads to incidents during upgrades and immediate rollbacks. This work reduces human error and provides an auditable, automated rotation path. What changed (high level): - terraform/modules/kms/*: new module that creates key, rotation schedule, IAM roles, and optional CloudHSM-backed key ring (AWS-specific example). Exposes the key alias used by the installer and outputs key metadata. - helm/private-installer/values.yaml: new flags: hsm.enabled, kms.provider (aws|gcp|azure|none), kms.key_alias, rotation.schedule, vault.path. - helm/private-installer/templates/rotation-controller-deployment.yaml: deploys rotation controller with PKCS#11 configuration when hsm.enabled=true. - operator/controllers/rotation_controller.go: new controller that integrates with Vault/KMS/PKCS#11 and updates Secrets via sealed-secrets re-sealing flow. - docs/private-installer/secrets-rotation.md: documented migration, emergency rollback steps, and SLO expectations. - tests/integration/rotation_e2e.sh: end-to-end test harness that spins up a kind cluster (or test cluster), mocks KMS and Vault endpoints, and validates non-exportable sign flows. Checklist (done): - [x] Terraform module + examples - [x] Helm chart values + templates - [x] Rotation controller implementation - [x] Sealed-secrets re-seal path + migration job - [x] Integration tests and CI pipeline steps - [x] Docs and release notes Compatibility and upgrade notes: This is opt-in. Default behavior is unchanged unless values.hsm.enabled or values.kms.provider is set. For clusters that currently use static TLS secrets, an automated migration job is provided: `rwdctl migrate-secrets --rehydrate` which will re-seal secrets and schedule the first rotation. The controller is designed to be safe during upgrades: it will create new keys/certs alongside existing ones and swap atomically once the new certs are ready. Security considerations: - Private key material is never exported from KMS/HSM; all signing is performed via provider APIs or PKCS#11. - Sealed-secrets re-sealing uses the cluster public key; we do not store unsealed secrets in the operator pod. A short-lived in-memory re-encryption path is used and strictly audited. - Audit logs are emitted to the configured audit sink (vault audit + cloud KMS audit) for each rotation event. Testing and CI: The first CI run showed failures in the e2e harness due to a mocking race with the Vault test server; fixed by adding better readiness checks. All pipeline checks now pass: unit tests, go vet, lint, helm lint, terraform validate, and the rotation e2e job (mocked). Migration plan: Ship as an opt-in release. Provide a migration job and CLI helpers. Customers on Dedicated/Enterprise channels will get a runbook and a maintenance window recommendation. If any issues occur, the rollback steps are: 1) disable rotation via values.kms.rotation.enabled=false, 2) re-apply previous static secrets from backup, 3) redeploy installer.

review_comments: Rohan Gupta (review): Does the PKCS#11 helper support multiple HSM vendors or only SoftHSM? Please add vendor matrix and test notes.
Ava Patel (reply): Added pkcs11_helper.go with vendor adapters and a vendor matrix in operator/controllers/README.md. We validated SoftHSM and AWS CloudHSM (via CloudHSM simulator) in CI mocks.
Emily Chen (review): We should ensure the rotation window prevents overlapping rotations in the same VPC; add terraform validation and a controller-level guard.

Ava Patel (reply): Added a terraform precondition that registers cluster rotation windows to a DynamoDB table (example) and a controller-side guard that rejects overlapping windows. See terraform/examples/kms-cloudhsm/example.tf and operator/controllers/rotation_controller.go.
Diego Morales (review): How do we ensure sealed-secrets re-seal doesn't leak plaintext if the operator crashes mid-migration?

Ava Patel (reply): The migration job writes progress to a Kubernetes Job and uses an emptyDir volume only for streaming; on crash we rollback to the last committed sealed secret and leave the original secret untouched. Details in docs/private-installer/secrets-rotation.md.
Emily Chen (approval): Integration tests look good; please address the small lint nit and squash the fix commits before merge.
release_notes: Automated TLS and KMS/HSM rotation for Private Installer (opt-in). Adds Terraform modules for KMS/HSM, Helm values to enable rotation controller, and a sealed-secrets re-seal migration path. See docs/private-installer/secrets-rotation.md for migration steps and rollback procedures.
